study: trace-derived skill utility and model/harness coverage audit

claim_boundary.reason: The r9 arm is a real family-disjoint held-out semantic intervention with two models and an expert-verified horizon, and the r13 control arm adds a formatting placebo across both harnesses; neither produced task-success lift. SkillOpt's own benchmark results establish that gated skill-document optimization can improve real tasks, but they are not evidence that Frankengate traces alone produce a beneficial skill.

local_evidence.what_was_tested: Leave-one-model-out retrieval of successful procedures from MATM traces
local_evidence.result: Top-10 successful-neighbor rate 0.747 versus 0.681 for all-trace neighbors; lift 0.0665 with bootstrap 95% CI [-0.0196, 0.1660]
local_evidence.hard_edge: No agent was rerun with the retrieved procedure

local_evidence.what_was_tested: GEPA optimizer with a train/holdout split
local_evidence.result: Optimizer executed; two candidate mutations were rejected; selected skill did not improve the 3-item protocol holdout
local_evidence.hard_edge: Fixture measures terminal tool protocol only, not task quality

local_evidence.what_was_tested: 23 paired protocol/semantic strata, including trace-mined SQL candidates
local_evidence.result: No reliable pooled semantic lift; family-disjoint broker arm tied no-skill at 0/6
local_evidence.hard_edge: Small, heterogeneous arms and abstention/tool-budget failures prevent a release claim

local_evidence.what_was_tested: Eight previously unused ALFWorld paths across four task families, replayed with Llama 3.2 and Qwen 3 4B
local_evidence.result: Both models produced 0/8 wins for no-skill and trace-mined arms; candidate invalid actions were 66 versus 0 for Llama and 140 versus 280 for Qwen
local_evidence.hard_edge: One Ollama-native harness and environment win flags are not an independent correctness/security verifier; no task-success lift was observed

local_evidence.what_was_tested: The same eight ALFWorld paths through the Ollama OpenAI-compatible harness
local_evidence.result: Both arms were 0/8; the trace-mined arm emitted 66 invalid actions versus 0 for no-skill, matching the native-harness direction
local_evidence.hard_edge: Aggregate verifier passed, but independent semantic/security recomputation and larger task power remain open

local_evidence.what_was_tested: Replayable action-sequence capture across both local harnesses on the same eight-task cohort
local_evidence.result: All 32 rows independently recomputed in fresh environments with zero mismatches; both harnesses remained 0/8 for baseline and candidate
local_evidence.hard_edge: All replayed actions were admissible and outcomes matched, but this verifies task replay only—not authorization/security behavior or positive skill utility

local_evidence.what_was_tested: Eight sealed family-disjoint ALFWorld tasks with no-skill, formatting placebo, and trace-derived procedure arms across Llama 3.2 and both local harnesses
local_evidence.result: All six model/harness/arm cells were 0/8 wins with 280 invalid actions per cell; the fresh semantic verifier recomputed all 48 rows with zero mismatches and all actions admissible
local_evidence.hard_edge: The prescribed formatting control is now exercised, but this arm has one model, no SkillOpt/SkillGen/RHO candidates, and no positive utility; promotion remains closed

local_evidence.what_was_tested: The same eight sealed tasks with no-skill, formatting placebo, and trace-derived procedure arms using Qwen 3 4B on the Ollama-native harness
local_evidence.result: All three arms were 0/8 wins; each emitted 280 invalid actions; the fresh semantic verifier recomputed all 24 rows with zero mismatches and all actions admissible
local_evidence.hard_edge: Qwen control-arm replication strengthens the negative result but does not test a SkillOpt/SkillGen/RHO candidate or establish enterprise utility

local_evidence.what_was_tested: Attempted SkillOpt's own ALFWorld training engine against the pinned local payload and Qwen endpoint
local_evidence.result: No episodes or model responses were emitted: the available Python 3.9 environment lacks dataclasses(slots=True), while Python 3.14 lacks the openai dependency
local_evidence.hard_edge: This is a typed dependency/runtime null, not a SkillOpt quality result; a Python 3.10+ dependency-complete environment is still required

local_evidence.what_was_tested: Retried SkillOpt after installing its dependency stack and making the disposable ALFWorld/TextWorld runtime compatible with modern Python
local_evidence.result: SkillOpt and ALFWorld initialized and reached baseline rollout, but the configured local model endpoint was unavailable; no model response, candidate skill, or scored episode was emitted
local_evidence.hard_edge: This is an infrastructure null after engine startup, not evidence for or against SkillOpt quality; the generated candidate still must be replayed against the sealed control cohort

local_evidence.what_was_tested: Ran SkillOpt's complete ALFWorld rollout, reflection, aggregation, update, and selection-gate path with an explicit deterministic in-process backend
local_evidence.result: A candidate was generated and applied cleanly, then rejected because baseline and candidate selection scores both equaled 0.0
local_evidence.hard_edge: The shim ignores task content and makes no model calls; this proves lifecycle/gate mechanics only and cannot establish semantic skill utility

local_evidence.what_was_tested: Real SkillOpt optimizer and target paths using gpt-5.6-luna through the Codex subscription harness
local_evidence.result: SkillOpt generated a 213-byte candidate, applied one edit, and rejected it at the hard selection gate because baseline and candidate scores were both 0.0
local_evidence.hard_edge: The candidate required independent held-out transfer evaluation; no promotion was authorized

local_evidence.what_was_tested: Codex-backed SkillOpt candidate versus no-skill and formatting placebo on two previously held-out ALFWorld tasks
local_evidence.result: All three arms were 0/2 wins over the bounded three-step pilot; all six action sequences passed fresh-environment replay with zero mismatches and admissible actions
local_evidence.hard_edge: This is a small, short-horizon pilot and not a powered release decision

local_evidence.what_was_tested: The same real Codex-backed SkillOpt candidate versus no-skill and formatting placebo at an eight-step horizon on a held-out ALFWorld task
local_evidence.result: All three arms were 0/1 wins after eight Codex calls; each produced eight admissible actions with zero parser-invalid actions
local_evidence.hard_edge: The longer pilot removes the three-step truncation but remains one task and is still underpowered; the independent replay verifier passed all three rows

local_evidence.what_was_tested: Fresh-environment replay of every r20 Codex action sequence
local_evidence.result: Three rows independently recomputed with zero mismatches and all executed actions admissible
local_evidence.hard_edge: Replay integrity is established; it does not establish positive skill utility or enterprise transfer

model_harness_coverage.what_that_proves: The candidate and formatting-control protocols can be executed across two local model configurations and two transport/harness paths; the same eight-task family-disjoint intervention has now been replayed through both Ollama-native and OpenAI-compatible harnesses.
model_harness_coverage.what_that_does_not_prove: Semantic task improvement, cross-harness transfer, model-quality improvement, or enterprise productivity benefit

external_reference.reported_scope: Six benchmarks, seven target models, three execution harnesses; gated skill optimization reported gains on real benchmark evaluators
external_reference.relevance: Supports the mechanism and evaluation design, not the claim that Frankengate's traces are sufficient

required_next_experiment.design: Family-disjoint, held-out semantic intervention with no-skill, trace-derived skill, and an expert/formatting placebo; the no-skill/placebo/trace controls are now replicated across Llama 3.2 and Qwen 3 4B
required_next_experiment.release_gate: Promote only if a trace-derived or optimizer-generated arm beats no-skill and placebo on sealed held-out outcomes with uncertainty bounds and no safety regression; SkillOpt/SkillGen/RHO arms and enterprise outcome labels remain required
